name: db
doc: Run SQL against this workspace's tables. Reads run on a snapshot; writes need edit rights and are not recorded in row history (use `records` for tracked edits). Statements are checked by the SQL authorizer: system tables, schema changes, PRAGMA and ATTACH are not allowed.

functions.name: query
functions.returns: array of row tables keyed by column name (SQL NULL is db.NULL)
functions.doc: Runs a read-only query and returns up to 10,000 rows.
functions.example: local rows = db.query("SELECT Name FROM Customers WHERE City = :city", {city = "Paris"})

functions.name: query_one
functions.doc: Like db.query but returns only the first row.
functions.example: local c = db.query_one("SELECT * FROM Customers WHERE id = :id", {id = 1})

functions.name: query_value
functions.returns: first column of the first row, or nil when there are no rows
functions.doc: Returns a single value.
functions.example: local n = db.query_value("SELECT count(*) FROM Orders")

functions.name: iter
functions.doc: Iterates over a large result in pages of 1,000 rows (jobs only).
functions.example: for row in db.iter("SELECT * FROM Orders") do total = total + row.Qty end

functions.name: exec
functions.doc: Runs one INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on a workspace table. Not available in reports.
functions.example: db.exec("UPDATE Orders SET Status = 'Shipped' WHERE id = :id", {id = 7})

functions.name: transaction
functions.doc: Runs fn inside one write transaction (all-or-nothing). Raising an error inside fn rolls back. The block has its own time budget (250 ms in form events, 2 s in jobs).
functions.example: db.transaction(function() db.exec("UPDATE Stock SET Qty = Qty - 1 WHERE id = :id", {id = 3}) records.insert("Moves", {Item = 3}) end)

functions.name: lookup
functions.doc: Access DLookup: the field's value in the first matching row, or db.NULL.

functions.name: count
functions.doc: Access DCount: number of matching rows (non-empty values of field, or all rows when field is "*" or omitted).

functions.name: sum
functions.doc: Access DSum.

functions.name: avg
functions.doc: Access DAvg.

functions.name: min
functions.doc: Access DMin.

functions.name: max
functions.doc: Access DMax.

functions.name: is_null
functions.doc: True for nil and db.NULL.

values.name: NULL
values.doc: SQL NULL. Lua tables cannot hold nil, so empty field values are db.NULL.

values.name: name
values.doc: Event name: load, current, before_insert, before_update, after_update, before_delete, after_delete, close, click, change, confirm.

values.name: control
values.doc: Name of the control that raised a control event.

values.name: old_value
values.doc: Previous value for change/before_update control events.

values.name: new_value
values.doc: New value for change/before_update control events.

values.name: args
values.doc: Arguments the form was opened with (open_args).

values.name: answer
values.doc: The user's answer when re-invoked after ui.confirm.

functions.name: toast
functions.doc: A brief message; level is "info" (default), "success", "warning" or "error".

functions.name: alert
functions.doc: A message the user must dismiss.

name: record
doc: The form's current record buffer. Read and assign fields by name (record.Qty = 5); assignments are sent back to the form and saved with the record.

functions.name: get
functions.doc: Reads a field (db.NULL when empty).

functions.name: set
functions.doc: Assigns a field.

values.name: id
values.doc: Row id (nil for a new record).

values.name: is_new
values.doc: True for a record not yet saved.

values.name: is_dirty
values.doc: True when the user changed fields.

name: records
doc: Read and change rows field by field, with the same validation, concurrency checks and history as the datasheet. Fields are named by their field (physical) names.

functions.name: get
functions.returns: row table (id, _version and every field; currency as decimal, yes/no as boolean, empty as db.NULL) or nil
functions.doc: Reads one row by id.

functions.name: insert
functions.doc: Creates a row and returns its id.

functions.name: update
functions.doc: Changes fields of a row. With version, fails if the row changed since that version; without it, applies to the current version.

functions.name: delete
functions.doc: Deletes a row.

name: ui
doc: Change the form: control properties, focus, navigation and confirmations.

functions.name: control
functions.doc: A snapshot of a control's properties (visible, enabled, locked, caption, value…).

functions.name: set
functions.doc: Changes control properties: visible, enabled, locked, required (booleans), caption, tooltip (text), tone ("default"|"warning"|"danger"|"success"), value (unbound controls).

functions.name: focus
functions.doc: Moves focus to a control.

functions.name: goto_record
functions.doc: Moves to a record: an id, or "next", "prev", "first", "last", "new".

functions.name: open_form
functions.doc: Opens another form, optionally filtered with a filter-model table and passing args.

functions.name: open_report
functions.doc: Opens a report.

functions.name: close
functions.doc: Closes the form.

functions.name: requery
functions.doc: Reloads the form's records, or one subform/combo box.

functions.name: cancel
functions.doc: Cancels the pending action (save, insert, delete) in before_* events and shows message.

functions.name: confirm
functions.doc: Asks the user to confirm. When answered, the form calls the handler function named continuation with event.answer set.

name: workspace
doc: Information about the workspace and the user the script runs as.

values.name: user
values.doc: {id, email, display_name, role} of the user (jobs run as the job principal).
